description: License policy for shipped components (M30, spec 15.4-15.5). Enforced by scripts/security/check_licenses.py on the SBOM and on the live lockfile closures. An SPDX expression passes when every AND term and at least one OR alternative is allowed for that component.

conditional.reason: The project's own application and worker license (spec 15.4).

PyInstaller's bootloader exception permits distributing frozen applications under any license.
